title: SpringTrap d4c (Jcraft: EOE)
description: Replaces d4c skin 2 with SpringTrap (JOJO, JJBA)
body:
Have you ever tought d4c looks like a rabbit. Who else looks like a rabbit? That's right, SpringTrap!

Replaces d4c skin 2 with SpringTrap.

Changes the appearence of your JoJo stand.

The USA flag is swapped with the romanian flag, DM  me on discord for a remake with your own flag: OmegaX3000

Make sure to check out my other content too, if there is any!
